data.one_liner: Tailwind‑style UI widgets and theming for Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of ready‑made Flutter widgets inspired by Tailwind UI, including theming, grid layouts, markdown rendering and syntax highlighting. It offers a design system that lets you style components consistently across platforms.
use_when: You want a Tailwind‑like design system without building components from scratch
You need ready‑made widgets such as grids, selectable lists and styled text
You prefer a declarative API that integrates with standard Flutter theming
avoid_when: You require platform‑specific (Material/Cupertino) look and feel
You need extensive widget variety beyond what the package offers
You rely on code‑generation tools for models or APIs
strengths: Includes theming, markdown and syntax‑highlight support
Active development with recent Flutter version support
weaknesses: Limited widget catalog compared to full UI frameworks
Early‑stage package may have breaking changes
Design may not match native platform conventions

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive Material‑design widget set with broad community support

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers native iOS‑style widgets for a platform‑consistent look
